description: Own fixed non-stationary uniform test values; NOT Hansmeyer's unpublished Illustration 1 parameters.
input: Single undecorated closed cube [-1,1]^3, 8 vertices and 6 quads
scheme: Modified Catmull-Clark only; no Doo-Sabin, fusing, locking, spatial weights or postprocessing
normal_convention: Existing implementation unchanged: unit input face normal times current face perimeter; input vertex normal is the arithmetic mean of these scaled incident face normals, without renormalization.
selection_reason: Alternate non-convex masks to test generation of new folds rather than return each generation to convex smoothing. Avoid exact w1=3 coincidence. Independent w12 supplies signed vertex-only normal displacement; weights_only has identical w1-w4 with w12=0.
paper_scope: 2010 pp76-77 Eqs1-4 and section3.1; p80 Illustration1. No numeric weight interval is specified. Finite extrapolating weights do not guarantee an embedded or printable surface.
